text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Satsuki Sho is here, and Tosen Jordan's nails somehow seem to be holding up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's made it this far, to this once-in-a-lifetime match against her peers. Her appearance surprises Nakayama Festa.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nakayama Festa explains that the Oka Sho has generated more buzz, but with Jordan competing, the dice have been recast.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This is only the beginning, she declares.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: These words come as something of a shock to Tosen Jordan, who was approaching this race as if it were her last.
